title: Château de Vincennes

geometry.axisMethod: minimum-area rectangle; +X longest axis; direction ambiguous by 180 degrees

identityStatus: Exact-QID castle boundary; local +X north and +Z east established by Tour du Village and keep positions

components.units: meters in same local XZ frame; Y elevations are not applied as local heights
components.notes: Aggregate castle building features combine ranges, walls and towers. Their single height is not imposed on every member. Reconstruction partitions these footprints using CMN plan/photos. IGN stated plan precision for keep is 3m and height precision 2.5m. The OSM outline includes the grounds and moat; do not fill it as a building.
